name: Warm heavenly supersaw pad with keytrack and lush FX
goal: Dial warm heavenly pads: saw unison 5–7 with moderated detune, slow attack/long release (velocity can shorten attack), 24 dB low-pass with no resonance and key tracking, subtle slow LFO→cutoff, rich chorus + low-cut reverb (~3s) + dotted-eighth stereo delay; optional PWM layer, serial HP to control sub build-up, sine reinforce, and a separate shimmer layer.

source.title: How to Make Super Warm, Heavenly Pads with Vital

prerequisites: VA/WT synth with unison, keytrack, chorus/delay/reverb, optional second instance for shimmer layer
constraints: Ground every step in the source YouTube-provided captions; do not invent UI or settings.
Original synthesis only — map brand UI (Serum/Vital/Pigments/Phase Plant/etc.) to portable osc/filter/FX roles for a browser or generic hybrid synth; never rip presets, wavetables, or samples.
Prefer transferable signal-flow and motion relationships over vendor-specific preset names.
Key tracking is required if fixed cutoff makes high chords disappear.
PWM layers need less unison/detune than supersaws to avoid overload.

steps.action: Saw osc, unison ~5–7, reduce detune from max; amp slow attack + long release; raise voice count for big chords.
Optional: velocity → attack with inverted depth (harder = shorter attack); straighten release curve if needed.
LP filter: zero resonance; 24 dB slope; cutoff for warm lows; compare analog/ladder/diode; enable key track until high notes remain audible in wide chords.
FX: rich chorus for constant motion; reverb with low cut, ~3s; dotted-eighth delay with stereo spread/ping-pong and controlled feedback.
Subtle slow irregular LFO → cutoff for life; EQ after FX as needed (gentle HP, optional shimmer highs).

Optional layer: PWM wavetable with moderate unison and slower PWM LFO; combine with supersaw; if subs build, serial HP after LP; optional unfiltered sine to reinforce fundamental against phase cancellation.
steps.expect: Organic combined pad with controlled lows

steps.action: Optional second patch/layer for shimmer (additive/WT, little unison, LFO→level or short decay + harmonic stretch); pitch-up delay/shimmer on that layer only.
steps.expect: High shimmer without wrecking warm body

verification: High and low chords both audible (keytrack working)
